name: spec-system
description: Spec-as-truth development: specs in specs/ are the source of truth, code is the artifact. Pins are content hashes — git holds spec history, no version numbers. Six skills: spec-init scaffolds the substrate + hook into any repo; spec-boundaries proposes capabilities from co-change evidence; spec-adopt describes existing code; spec-review checks diffs against pinned specs; spec-amend edits a spec and derives the plan from the delta; spec-implement builds test-first and moves the pin last.
